notes:
Account summary:
- HelioHealth is evaluating Redwood for Dedicated capacity to support regulated change approvals around model updates.
- Primary theme from calls: "We can’t have the model change behavior without a paper trail." They want customer-visible release notes + a way to prove what changed, when.

Workload / product fit:
- Likely mix of summarization + internal doc search. Mentioned clinician-facing workflow + customer support knowledge base.
- Preference: Dedicated GPU pool (predictability + isolation). Not pushing for full on-prem at this stage, but wants VPC option / private networking.
- Important: ability to pin model versions for clinical validation periods; needs rollouts to be explicit (canary/A-B) with rollback plan.

Key requirements captured (POC gating):
- Customer-visible model changelog / release notes:
  - Per model version release notes with date, compatibility notes, and deprecation timelines.
  - Must be immutable or at least tamper-evident (corrections should preserve history).
  - Needs a machine-readable feed (JSON preferred; RSS acceptable as secondary).
  - Want linkable “what version did we run?” evidence for internal change-control board.
- Versioning/pinning:
  - Must be able to pin a specific model version in production.
  - Must be able to confirm resolved model_version in responses (header/field) for audit.
- Compliance/security:
  - Audit logs for model metadata changes + who approved/published customer-visible notes.
  - Retention controls for audit events (asked about 1y+ retention, immutability).
  - KMS integration and clear RBAC around who can publish changes.
  - Data residency question came up (they have US-only requirements for now; may need EU later).

Recent activity timeline:
- 2026-02-05: Intro/discovery notes captured by owner (high-level Dedicated interest, asked about version pinning).
- 2026-02-14: POC scoping call (Fireflies: ff_2026-02-14_heliohealth_poc_scoping). Success criteria explicitly included receiving release notes for any model/version changes during trial.
- 2026-02-20: Internal follow-up between owner + SE: align messaging on upcoming model metadata + changelog work; plan to position as beta for early enterprise.

POC sketch (draft):
- 2–3 week Dedicated trial.
- Redwood provides: pinned model version, defined rollout policy, and changelog entry links in Console (or docs) for any changes.
- HelioHealth provides: prompt set + expected output checks for regression testing.

Contacts (from notes):
- Director of Platform Engineering (buyer champion; cares about auditability)
- Security/Compliance lead (wants formal documentation, retention guarantees)
- PM for clinical workflows (wants predictable behavior + rollback)

Risks / watch-outs:
- They are sensitive to wording: do not reference internal model nicknames or infrastructure details; keep release notes customer-safe.
- If we cannot provide a credible changelog + approval workflow story, they will default to a vendor with stronger “release management” controls even at higher cost.

Internal next steps:
- SE (Ethan Park) to share Dedicated/VPC architecture overview + how version pinning works today.
- Owner (Talia Benson) to schedule security review and set expectation on changelog beta timeline (Console/docs + feed).
- If they want formal enterprise language: loop in Security/Compliance reviewers (Marcus Lin / Olga Petrov) once we have their questionnaire.
